MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.

2. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

3. When practising Oral Expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expressions.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expressions.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expressions.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expressions.

4. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.

5. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

6. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
